Since the `BundlingService.cs` file is quite large, I will focus on creating a test that specifically targets the call to `Logger.LogInformation` on line 112, which is within the `else` branch of the `if (bundleConfig.Mode is BundlingMode.Bundle || bundleConfig.Mode is BundlingMode.BundleAndMinify)` condition. 

To do this, I need to:
- Instantiate `BundlingService`.
- Mock `ILogger<BundlingService>`.
- Set up the necessary dependencies and state so that the code reaches the `else` branch.
- Call the `BundleAsync` method with parameters that will trigger the `else` branch.
- Verify that `LogInformation("Generating script references...")` is called.

I'll prepare a minimal test that does this. Since the code depends on many other parts, I will mock or stub out the dependencies as needed, especially `ILogger`.

Let's proceed with the test implementation.

using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Volo.Abp.Cli.Bundling;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System;

namespace BundlingServiceTests
{
    public class BundleAsyncTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task BundleAsync_Should_Log_GenerateScriptReferences_When_Mode_Is_Not_Bundle()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<BundlingService>>();
            var bundlingService = new BundlingService
            {
                Logger = loggerMock.Object,
                ScriptBundler = new Mock<IScriptBundler>().Object,
                StyleBundler = new Mock<IStyleBundler>().Object,
                ConfigReader = new Mock<IConfigReader>().Object
            };

            // Setup minimal dependencies and state
            var bundleConfig = new BundleConfig
            {
                Mode = BundlingMode.None,
                InteractiveAuto = true,
                IsBlazorWebApp = false,
                Name = "TestBundle"
            };

            var bundleDefinitions = new List<BundleTypeDefinition>();
            var bundleDefinitionsField = typeof(BundlingService).GetField("bundleDefinitions", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            // We can't set private fields directly, so we will simulate the call path by calling BundleAsync with a setup that triggers the else branch.

            // We need to mock or stub methods: GetStyleContext, GetScriptContext, GenerateStyleDefinitions, GenerateScriptDefinitions, UpdateDependenciesInBlazorFileAsync
            // For simplicity, we will create a derived class that overrides these methods to return controlled values.

            var testService = new TestBundlingService(loggerMock.Object);

            // Act
            await testService.BundleAsync("dummyDir", false);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("Generating style references..."), Times.Once);
            loggerMock.Verify(x => x.LogInformation("Generating script references..."), Times.Once);
        }

        private class TestBundlingService : BundlingService
        {
            private readonly ILogger<BundlingService> _logger;
            public TestBundlingService(ILogger<BundlingService> logger)
            {
                _logger = logger;
                this.Logger = logger;
            }

            public override async Task BundleAsync(string directory, bool forceBuild, string projectType = BundlingConsts.WebAssembly)
            {
                // Call base method but override parts to force else branch

                await base.BundleAsync(directory, forceBuild, projectType);
            }

            protected override string GenerateStyleDefinitions(BundleContext styleContext) => "styleDefs";
            protected override string GenerateScriptDefinitions(BundleContext scriptContext) => "scriptDefs";

            protected override BundleContext GetStyleContext(List<BundleTypeDefinition> bundleDefinitions, BundleConfig bundleConfig)
            {
